_meta.source: Joveo Media Planning Approach — client pitch deck (Invisible Technologies)
_meta.methodology: Curated from the official Joveo 2026 client media-plan deck ('Invisible Media Planning Approach'). Encodes Joveo's campaign methodology, push/pull channel framework, CPA reference benchmarks, sample pricing model, differentiators and case-study outcomes so Nova and the Media Plan Generator can cite the canonical approach.

tagline: High Performance, AI-Led Recruitment Marketing Platform
positioning: Joveo is delivered as a managed service: the client provides strategic direction and approves outcomes while Joveo handles execution across one tracked funnel from apply-start to hire.

campaign_methodology.description: Joveo's 6-step campaign management methodology — each step is operated by Joveo on the MOJO platform.

steps.name: Benchmarking & Market Research
steps.detail: Talent supply vs. demand, competitive landscape, and hiring difficulty by role category set the plan baseline.

steps.name: Develop Media Strategy
steps.detail: Build the budget plan by campaign, role, location and talent profile; reallocate weekly.

steps.name: Campaign Launch & Publisher Optimization
steps.detail: Push jobs live across the channel mix; AI shifts bids and budget daily to the best publishers per job.

steps.name: Passive Candidate Outreach
steps.detail: Engage passive candidates via databases, email/SMS re-engagement and conversion-optimized landing pages.

steps.name: Candidate Quality Optimization
steps.detail: Screen and qualify candidates in the apply flow to lift quality.

steps.name: Optimize to Down-Funnel Conversions
steps.detail: Optimize toward apply-start → apply-finish → hire, with click-to-hire attribution.

push_meets_pull.summary: Joveo combines active outreach (Push) with employer-brand magnetism (Pull).

push.name: Push = Active Outreach
push.detail: Targeted ads, job alerts, social media and email campaigns that proactively push opportunities to candidates based on behavior, job demographics, or intent signals.

pull.name: Pull = Employer Brand Magnetism
pull.detail: Content, reputation, social media and SEO-optimized career pages that pull candidates in by building long-term interest and trust.

channel_mix.description: Entry-point channel mix — highest-volume, highest-ROI channels first. 'type' classifies each as Push or Pull.

channels.purpose: Drive high-volume developer & reviewer applicant flow
channels.notes: Primary volume driver; target by skill, role, and remote keyword
Best for senior devs, computational scientists, STEM PhDs

channels.purpose: Generate fast applications from language & writing experts
channels.notes: Strong for freelance-oriented talent; mobile-first apply
Target 'AI training jobs remote', 'remote coding jobs'
Ideal for niche skills; talent already used to contract work
Higher relevance, lower volume; good for hard-to-fill roles

channels.purpose: Build awareness among passive technical talent
channels.notes: Target coding forums, tech news, LeetCode, HackerRank

cpa_reference.description: Baseline CPAs by role category, calibrated from Joveo benchmarks. US/global remote; varies by geography, language and seasonality.

roles.basis: Joveo benchmark: high-volume remote tech roles
Slightly higher due to broader skill requirements
Niche skills; limited to specialized channels
Very scarce talent pool; aligned with nurse-level CPAs

hiring_difficulty.description: Hiring difficulty by role category (Benchmarking & Market Research).

sample_pricing_model.description: Sample campaign pricing — priced to onboarded trainers who clear screening; ~20 hires each; conversion set conservatively from funnel data. Budget = Hires × Applies/Hire × CPA.
sample_pricing_model.budget_formula: Hires × Applies per Hire × CPA = Budget

campaigns.targeting: Global English: US, UK, India, PH

channel_sourcing.channels: Indeed, LinkedIn, Meta / Instagram, Google Search
Indeed India, Naukri, Meta, regional boards
Meta, Catho / Vagas, Google Search, local boards
LinkedIn, JobKorea / Saramin, local social, niche tech

sample_pricing_model.note: Korean needs a longer flight and a wider stack, which is why it carries the premium. Abundant languages fill fast and cheap; plan Korean's timeline and budget up front.

differentiators.title: AI Labs Experience
differentiators.detail: Delivered media strategy for the top players in data labeling worldwide — direct competitors to Invisible Tech. We understand this talent market better than anyone.

differentiators.title: Global Multi-Language Reach
differentiators.detail: Proven playbooks for sourcing technical talent in local languages across 50+ countries — databases, DSPs, social, freelancing platforms, and local job boards.

differentiators.title: AI-Powered Optimization
differentiators.detail: Real-time bid and budget optimization at the individual job level; autonomous budget orchestration shifts spend from easy-to-fill to hard-to-fill roles.

differentiators.title: Job Content Optimization
differentiators.detail: JD scoring engine + automated job creation ensures high-converting, SEO-optimized listings (a key gap identified at Scale AI: 71% vs. 90%+ target).

differentiators.title: Move at the Speed of AI
differentiators.detail: Automated programmatic engine goes from job-feed approval to live, optimized global campaigns in under 12 hours.

case_study.title: Hiring high-quality AI Trainers at scale
case_study.client_context: Global end-to-end AI solutions provider working with all top AI companies; required experts across the globe spanning generalists, coders, mathematicians, freelancers and language experts.
challenges: Heavy dependence on a few key job boards, limiting scale and qualified candidates
Needed a partner that could meet their speed and campaign-scale requirements
Lack of an omni-channel strategy to attract active and passive candidates
Irregular pacing, spend and ROI metrics; high costs during campaign peaks
solution: Introduced a broader mix of media channels beyond standard job boards (database partnerships, CPQA partners)
Launched campaigns with 24h TAT and scaled to thousands of applications within the first 2–3 days
Activated specialized boards, community sites and local job boards
Optimized toward cost-per-activation and provider quality metrics to improve ROI

results.detail: Increase in qualified applications across various campaigns

Integrate the client job feed with the Joveo platform
Launch campaign within 2 business weeks of feed integration
30-day review: CPA actuals, pipeline quality, scale-up recommendation
